note: Machine draft from knowledge of the standard South African Tshivenda calendar names. Short forms are first letters, except Fulwana which is shortened to Fwan so it differs from Fulwi (Fulw). Spelling variants exist in older sources (e.g. Ṱhafamuhwe/Thafamuhwe, Nyendavhusiku/Nyendavhusika); diacritics are kept as ṱ and ḽ.
